top_signals.title: SK Hynix’s $570 Billion Selloff Shows Cracks in Memory-Chip Boom
top_signals.summary: A $570 billion rout in just a little over a month has flipped SK Hynix Inc. from one of the world’s hottest AI trades to one of the biggest portfolio question marks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: U.S. and Korean tech stocks are now tightly linked — and that could be a worry for investors
top_signals.summary: The 60-day correlation between the Kospi and Nasdaq 100 recently climbed to about 0.50, its highest level since 2021, according to data provided by Rayliant.
